what: Envato rolled out AI-powered vector search to every category on Elements and reports these changes resulted in higher search-to-download ratios and a better customer experience.
verbatim_snippet: "We used AI-driven filters and metadata improvements to show customers more of what they wanted and less of what they didn't ask for. Across the board, these changes resulted in higher search-to-download ratios and a better customer experience."
notes: Page returns 403 on direct access. Snippet from search engine index tied to this specific URL (Author Hub version of Envato Unpacked 2025). "Higher search-to-download ratios" is a self-reported platform metric without disclosed methodology, sample, or baseline.
